clause_1_plan_report_preservation.detail: Copied immutable ARCHIVE_RESURRECTION_SA_SD.md and LEGACY_CLOSEOUT_RECONCILIATION.md into docs/04/pantheon_first_release_closure_2026-09-06/ matching exact SHA256 hashes byte-for-byte. Updated INDEX.md to reference both documents.

clause_2_single_reconciliation_authority.detail: Extended existing reconcile_merged_done and _validated_same_delivery_archive_recovery in scripts/ai_status.py; did not create any secondary reconciler, store, or queue.

clause_3_strict_proof_requirements.detail: Enforces exact merged original delivery/review with all 4 required review bindings (file, commit, merge_target_ref, merge_target_sha), byte-preserved archive snapshot with separate raw file SHA256 binding, identical scope contract (spec hash, acceptance, artifacts, dependencies, dev_bridge, execution_authorization), and complete authenticated ordered lineage chain (audit events) proving stale role-only resurrection. Completion tracks must also be identical; a functional/hosted milestone blocks reuse of the original completion.

clause_4_archive_and_generation_preserva.detail: Preserves original archive bytes and terminal fact generation (g1); retires only the proved stale active row (g2); records retired row digest and generation in append-only activity log.

clause_5_preflight_cas_binding.detail: Preflight CAS binds task, generation, spec hash, task digest, archive digest, raw archive file sha256, delivery, and audit proof range; revalidates inside authoritative transaction; excludes live worker/lease/queue. Audit CAS now binds the complete ordered task history and every event payload, including the historical prefix; timestamps cannot remove events from the binding.

clause_6_idempotent_retirement_and_recur.detail: Uses existing archive outbox/receipt/recovery ordering for idempotent crash-safe retirement across all 4 crash boundaries (before_commit, pending_status, readback, receipt). Blocks recurrence at admission/reassignment boundaries (command_assign, command_reopen, dev_bridge_materialize); preserves existing empty-genesis fail-closed behavior in seed_task_state_v2.py.

clause_7_execution_auth_boundary_preserv.detail: Preserves accepted execution-authorization and retired-review trust boundaries from predecessors. Archive recovery does not acquire or clear privileged authority, merge packet-source trust into MFA trust, or require product login for local maintenance.

clause_8_positive_fixtures_and_crash_rec.detail: Positive fixtures with genuine isolated command runtime and git ancestry, executing real isolated CLI invocations (ai_status.py show, reconcile_merged_done, and recover) without in-process mocks; authenticated import provenance with mandatory exact bindings (generation, archive_generation, owner, reviewer, archive_snapshot_sha256, operator_mode: 'local_human_ops', agent: 'Human/Ops') and authenticated event_id against payload digest; deterministic real-process barriers covering mutation and active worker claim between preflight and commit via production runtime_state_update lock; crash interruption across all four crash boundaries (before_commit, pending_status, readback, receipt), restart recovery, proof-change refusal, outbox receipt convergence, and idempotent recovery with exact byte, generation, and archive checks. Additional real two-process recovery-versus-assign test proves assign is rejected at terminal admission during the preflight barrier, after which recovery preserves g1 and exact archive bytes. Existing note-mutation CAS and active-execution claim races also pass.

clause_9_zero_effect_negatives.detail: Zero-effect negatives verified for unauthenticated import (missing event_id, unauthorized actor, missing or invalid operator_mode, missing/mismatched generation, archive_generation, owner, reviewer, archive_snapshot_sha256, unauthenticated event_id digest), corrupt/malformed runtime structures (dict or list workers, queue, leases, supervisor reservations with launch_intent), active review invalidation/rejection, missing review evidence fields (file, commit, merge_target_ref, merge_target_sha), raw archive byte drift, intervening new work, nonoperator invocations, and concurrent CAS/proof forks. Reviewer P1 regressions add actual CLI milestone and non-role lifecycle events, plus backdated/undated/invalid-time events inserted after import and after reassignment. Rejection preserves exact journal, activity, archive, canonical state and runtime bytes. Unknown lifecycle events fail closed; ordered authenticated historical prefixes remain eligible.
